description: New additive fields (revenue_today_usd, revenue_by_source, tags, log_feed, net_worth_src) must be inside the signed message to be authenticated AND persisted: telemetry.js:29 upserts v.payload = the parsed signed message. The documented signer canonicalMessage() (telemetry-verify.js:7-13) serializes a FIXED field set that excludes all new fields, and the spec has no requirement to extend it. Result: a canonical client never emits tags (R7 #agent-hackathon/Ours classification has no data source) OR tags are bolted on unsigned (a security-relevant 'who is Ours' categorization is unauthenticated). INV-OWN-STATE (behavioral-spec.md:77-78) says nothing about which fields the signature must cover.
